description: This is a PHP source file defining the EmploymentStatusDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides data access methods for EmploymentStatus entities, including CRUD operations and search functionalities. The class extends a base DAO and interacts with an ORM to perform database queries related to employment statuses.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing EmploymentStatus entities, providing methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employment status records.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Retrieves an employment status entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmploymentStatusIds
methods.description: Returns an array of IDs for employment statuses that exist among the provided list of IDs.

methods.name: saveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Persists a given EmploymentStatus entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Deletes employment status records by their IDs.

methods.name: searchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Searches for employment statuses matching the provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmploymentStatusPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Paginator for employment status search results, applying sorting and filtering based on search parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employment statuses matching the search filter.
